note: {name} = 예약자 영문 이름(예약 지갑을 열면 자동으로 채워짐), {spouse} = wife/husband (설정의 '이 폰 주인'에 따라 바뀜)

situations.title: 입국 심사
situations.tip: 질문에 짧고 분명하게 답하면 됩니다. 숙소 이름과 돌아가는 날짜를 바로 말할 수 있게 준비하세요.

phrases.en: We're here on our honeymoon.
phrases.they: What's the purpose of your visit?

phrases.en: We'll be staying for twelve nights.
phrases.they: How long will you be staying?

phrases.en: We're staying at the Hilton Garden Inn in Waikiki, and then on the Big Island.
phrases.ko: 와이키키 힐튼가든인에 묵고, 그다음엔 빅아일랜드로 가요.

phrases.en: Yes, we're traveling together. We just got married.
We have some packaged snacks to declare. No meat and no fresh fruit.
phrases.ko: 신고할 포장 과자가 있어요. 고기나 생과일은 없어요.
phrases.they: Are you bringing any food with you?

situations.title: 렌터카
situations.tip: 코나 공항 알라모 · 쉐보레 · 11/19 픽업, 11/25 반납. 추가 보험·업그레이드 권유는 필요 없으면 정중히 거절하세요.

phrases.en: Hi, I have a reservation under {name}.
phrases.they: Can I see your driver's license and a credit card?

phrases.en: Here's my international driving permit and my Korean license.
No, thank you. I'll stick with what I booked.
phrases.they: Would you like to add extra coverage or upgrade your car?

phrases.en: Do I need to return it with a full tank?
Where do I return the car at Kona airport?

situations.title: 호텔
situations.tip: 체크인 때 여권과 보증금용 신용카드를 요청합니다. 신혼여행이라고 말하면 작은 배려를 받을 때가 있어요.

phrases.en: Hi, we'd like to check in. The reservation is under {name}.
phrases.they: May I have your passport and a credit card for incidentals?

phrases.en: We're on our honeymoon. Is there any chance of a room with a nice view?
Could we leave our bags here until check-in?
phrases.ko: 체크인 전까지 짐을 맡길 수 있을까요?

phrases.en: Could we get two more towels, please?
phrases.ko: 수건 두 장 더 주실 수 있나요?

phrases.en: What time is check-out? Is a late check-out possible?
phrases.ko: 체크아웃은 몇 시예요? 늦은 체크아웃이 가능할까요?

situations.title: 식당
situations.tip: 미국은 계산서에 팁을 직접 적습니다 (보통 18~22%). 이미 포함됐는지 꼭 확인하세요 — 경비 화면에 팁 계산기가 있어요.

phrases.en: We have a reservation for two at six thirty, under {name}.
What do you recommend?
I'd like the steak medium rare, please.
phrases.they: How would you like your steak cooked?

phrases.en: Could we get the check, please?
phrases.they: Can I get you anything else?

phrases.en: Is the tip already included?

situations.title: 투어 체크인
situations.tip: 쿠알로아는 11:55까지 체크인 (여권 + 확정 이메일). 예약 지갑의 확정번호를 바로 보여줄 수 있게 열어 두세요.

phrases.en: Hi, we're here to check in for the UTV tour at twelve forty.
phrases.they: Can I see your confirmation and a photo ID?
phrases.they_ko: 예약 확인서와 사진이 있는 신분증을 보여 주시겠어요?

phrases.en: Here's our confirmation email and our passports.
Where is the meeting point for the tour?
Is there a locker where we can leave our bags?
Could you take a picture of us, please?
phrases.ko: 저희 사진 좀 찍어 주실 수 있나요?

situations.title: 쇼핑 · 환불
situations.tip: 가격표는 세금 제외입니다. 하와이는 계산할 때 약 4.7%가 더 붙어요.

phrases.en: Do you have this in a smaller size?
Can I try this on?
I'm just looking, thank you.
phrases.they: Can I help you find anything?

phrases.en: How much is it with tax?
I'd like to return this. Here's the receipt.
phrases.ko: 이거 환불하고 싶어요. 영수증 여기 있어요.

situations.title: 길 묻기 · 교통
situations.tip: 주유소는 대부분 셀프·선불입니다. 주유기에서 한국 카드가 안 되면 매장 안에서 주유기 번호를 말하고 결제하세요.

phrases.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the Royal Hawaiian Center?
Is it within walking distance?
phrases.they: It's about a ten-minute walk from here.

phrases.en: Could you take us to the Hilton Garden Inn on Kuhio Avenue?
phrases.ko: 쿠히오 애비뉴에 있는 힐튼가든인으로 가 주세요.

phrases.en: Where is the pickup area for ride shares?
My card isn't working at the pump. Can I pay inside for pump number three?
phrases.ko: 주유기에서 카드가 안 돼요. 3번 주유기를 안에서 계산할 수 있나요?

situations.title: 긴급 (분실 · 병원)
situations.tip: 경찰·구급·소방은 모두 911. 위치를 물으면 호텔 이름이나 일정 화면의 주소를 그대로 읽어 주세요.

phrases.en: Please call an ambulance.
phrases.they: Nine one one, what's your emergency?

phrases.en: I lost my passport. Where is the nearest police station?
phrases.ko: 여권을 잃어버렸어요. 가장 가까운 경찰서가 어디예요?

phrases.en: I need to see a doctor. Is there an urgent care clinic nearby?
phrases.ko: 진료를 받아야 해요. 근처에 응급 진료소가 있나요?

phrases.en: My {spouse} isn't feeling well. Do you have anything for motion sickness?
phrases.ko: 배우자가 몸이 안 좋아요. 멀미약 있나요?

phrases.en: Our rental car has a flat tire. Could you send roadside assistance?
phrases.ko: 렌터카 타이어가 펑크 났어요. 긴급출동을 보내 주실 수 있나요?
